tasks.description: Validate that improved error handling constructs do not introduce command injection risks or mask original exit codes.

Audit the systemd sandboxing directives in neos-autoupdate.service and neos-liveuser-setup.service. Ensure no critical privileges are unnecessarily granted. Ensure ReadWritePaths are strictly minimal.
Audit desktop configuration security. Audit newly introduced configuration files for potential privilege escalation vectors or unintended execution paths.
Audit PackageKit privilege contexts and ensure unprivileged users cannot bypass authentication for system-level package installations.
Fix CWE-59 predictable temp file vulnerability in neos-welcome using mktemp.
